scenarios.title: Bullish Breakout & Retest: USD/JPY
scenarios.questionText: Notice candle 7 closing above 1.2000, followed by candles 8-9 pulling back to test the broken level before expanding higher. What sequence just completed?
options: Breakout + Retest Confirmation (Old Resistance flips to New Support)
Failed Breakout (Bull Trap) collapsing back into the range
Immediate Momentum Exhaustion and reversal
Symmetrical Triangle tightening without directional bias
scenarios.correctAnswer: Breakout + Retest Confirmation (Old Resistance flips to New Support)
scenarios.explanation: Candle 7 decisively breached the horizontal resistance at 1.2000. Candles 8-9 retested the breakout level from above, finding bid support, before launching continuation upwards.
